laws.rule: San Luis Potosí bans selling, giving and drinking alcohol of any strength on the public road, sports fields and outdoor leisure places, unless the place has the right licence (Ley de Bebidas Alcohólicas, art. 43). Venues must stop selling on election days under federal and state electoral law, and on days councils set (art. 30). Text held on OJN, last reform 4 September 2024.

local-law.notes: Added 8 November 2026 from the federal Orden Jurídico Nacional (OJN) compilation of the state's laws. OJN versions can lag the state gazette, so entries name the last reform shown on the text where it was visible. Amounts in MXN; A$1 = about MXN 13.23 (as used elsewhere in this repo); UMA 2026 = MXN 117.31.
